name: invoices-service-da
query: Lav en faktura til {service_customer} på 3 timers konsulentbistand à 950 kr.
expected_behavior: Bills the hours either as a service-type line on a revenue G/L account (DocType dDocument_Service) or on an existing labour/service item resolved live, and says which it chose or asks the user
Resolves the customer, and the revenue account or item it bills on, from live data; asks when several fit; never invents an account number or item code
Computes the line total as 2850 (3 x 950) before VAT
Stops before posting: shows a confirmation receipt and asks to confirm, or first asks for a choice it could not resolve (account or item); never posts with a guessed account
